title: Atelier Marchant October 10
content: For those of you in the northern Los Angeles/ San Fernando Valley area, I'll be doing a three-part lecture series October 10th, 2010 from 1pm-5pm at the Atelier Marchant.The lectures include "Imaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't Exist" at 1:00, "Color and Light: Tools for Mood and Atmosphere" at 2:30 and "Plein Air Pioneers: Tradition and Technique" at 4:00.The fee is $30  for each lecture or $65 for the entire day. Call 661.350.1579 or email marchantatelier@gmail.com to register.Marchant Atelier Blog with more info.Earlier GJ post about other upcoming workshops in California
